intro: People all over the world care for their health. In China, people do tai chi in parks. In India, people stretch with yoga. Families everywhere share warm soup and rest.
You can help keep yourself safe too. You can wear a helmet. You can buckle up. You can learn stop, drop and roll.
In this unit, you will learn healthy ways from around the world. You will learn how to stay safe each day. You will know who to ask for help.
bigQuestion: How do people around the world stay well and safe?

timeline.t: Wake up after a good night of sleep.
Stretch with a yoga tree pose or slow tai chi moves.
Buckle up in the back seat for the ride to school.
Hold a grown-up's hand and cross at the crosswalk.
Put on sunscreen and a hat before playing outside.
Put on a helmet before riding a bike or scooter.
Eat a warm dinner with family, maybe with spices.
Practice the fire escape plan and your address.

words.d: how well your body and mind are doing
slow, gentle moves done with calm breathing
stretching and holding shapes while breathing slowly
something that helps you feel better
testing ideas to find out what is true
a hard hat that protects your head
a lotion that helps keep the sun from burning your skin
a grown-up you can trust to help you

test.q: Which slow, gentle moves do many people in China do in parks?
test.why: Tai chi is slow, gentle moving, often done in parks in China.

test.q: Which spice is yellow and comes from a root?
test.why: Turmeric is a yellow spice from a root, used in India.

test.q: Who were the first peoples of the Americas?
test.why: Indigenous peoples are the first peoples of a land.

test.q: What helps your body heal when you are sick?
Why tell your doctor about teas and herbs?
test.why: Doctors ask about home remedies to keep you safe.

test.q: What do you wear on your head when you ride a scooter?
test.why: A helmet protects your head if you fall.

test.q: Where do kids ride in a car?
test.why: Kids ride buckled up in the back seat.

test.q: What should you do if you find medicine?
choices: Do not touch and tell a grown-up

test.q: What do you do if your clothes catch fire?
test.why: Stop, drop and roll puts out the flames.

choices: A grown-up you can trust, like a teacher
test.why: A safe adult is a grown-up you can trust, like a parent, teacher or school nurse.

write.prompt: What is one healthy or safe thing you will do this week? Tell or draw it. Use two things you learned in this unit to say why it helps.
tips: Name the healthy or safe thing.
Tell where you learned about it.
Use a unit word, like helmet or yoga.
Draw a picture to show it.
